title: Account lifecycle states, holds and closure authority
workflow: Check current state, version and legal/financial preconditions
Evaluate outstanding mandates, claims, lien, payments and balances
Route controlled actions to independent checker
Apply new state once and publish scoped event
Retain prior status and incident/appeal evidence
invariants: State change must not mutate posted ledger history
Account closure cannot erase positive or negative financial obligations
Unreconciled transfers or holds prevent unsafe closure
Expired holds require explicit legal release policy not timer guess
No self-approval for finance-sensitive state change
Historical statements use contemporaneous state and product version
approval_gate: Institution-approved lifecycle and dormant-account policy; ledger reconciliation and operator approval rules.
